mapper.select: SELECT instrument_id AS instrumentId, symbol, ticker, asset_class AS assetClass, quote_currency AS quoteCurrency, status, delisted_at AS delistedAt FROM instrument WHERE symbol = #{symbol}
SELECT instrument_id AS instrumentId, symbol, ticker, asset_class AS assetClass, quote_currency AS quoteCurrency, status, delisted_at AS delistedAt FROM instrument WHERE instrument_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO instrument (symbol, ticker, asset_class, quote_currency, status) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{ticker}, 'EQUITY', COALESCE(UPPER(#{quoteCurrency,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), 'USD'), #{status}) ON CONFLICT (symbol) DO NOTHING
